current_activity: The 3rd Panzer Grenadier Division holds the First Army line north of Nancy opposite the 80th Division bridgehead
notes: Event date: CMH Lorraine Campaign ch. 2 p. 80: "In front of the 80th extended the southern wing of the 3d Panzer Grenadier Division"; "Somewhat south of Bezaumont the sector of the 3d Panzer Grenadier Division joined that of the 553d VG Division. On 12 September there was something of a gap between these two German divisions"; ch. 1 p. 49: "North of Nancy the line was manned by the 3d Panzer Grenadier Division". Event definition: the situation of 12 September. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Dieulouard with a precision of 10 km, the centre of the sector opposite the 80th Division bridgehead. Location approximate: a sector point; the division command post is not named. Location support: CMH names the sector from Pagny-sur-Moselle to Millery. Commander: Generalmajor Hans Hecker. Opponents: US 80th Infantry Division.

current_activity: The 3rd Panzer Grenadier Division withdraws to the line Sillegny-Seille-Port-sur-Seille-Landremont
notes: Event date: CMH Lorraine Campaign ch. 2 p. 114: "On 17 September the 80th erased the last vestiges of resistance in the Forêt de Facq. The 3d Panzer Grenadier Division was already in process of withdrawing to a new position, which extended from the left flank of the 17th SS Panzer Grenadier Division south of Sillegny, followed the Seille River as far as Port-sur-Seille, and then made contact with the 553d VG Division just east of Landremont". Event definition: the withdrawal under way on 17 September. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Sillegny with a precision of 10 km, the northern end of the new line. Location approximate: a line point. Location support: CMH names the line. Commander: Generalmajor Hans Hecker. Opponents: US 80th Infantry Division.
